column_description: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each condition assessment record.
TEXT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Links to the artifact under assessment. (In practice, should match CHAR(10) type if needed.)
TEXT FOREIGN KEY referencing Showcases(ShowcaseReg). Ties the record to the showcase if it was part of the assessment.
BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing LightAndRadiationReadings(LightRadRegistry). Associates the assessment with relevant light data.
INT rating or score representing the artifact/showcase condition (scale is flexible).
DATE when the conservation assessment took place.
DATE by which the next condition assessment should occur.
